terms.title: Terms of use and community charter

charter.title: The charter
charter.respect: We treat others with respect, whatever their country, language or level.
charter.abuse: No harassment, hate speech, scams or spam, in messages or in groups.
charter.code: In a hackathon, the code you submit is your team’s own. An instructor helps you learn, not with the solution.
charter.honesty: Level and experience must be declared honestly: the mentor badge depends on them.

moderation.title: What we do when there is a problem
moderation.text: Every member can report a profile, a message, a conversation or an invitation, and block someone. The KABAD team reviews reports: it can dismiss them, remove a message, warn or suspend an account. Every decision is recorded.

data.title: Your data
data.kept: We keep what the service needs: your profile, your messages, your mentoring sessions, your solutions and your test reports.
data.account: From “My account”, you can download all your data and delete your account at any time.
data.contact: For any question about your data, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

prizes.title: Hackathons and their prizes
prizes.text: The organizer of a hackathon announces its prizes and hands them over to the teams, in the order of the ranking. KABAD neither holds nor pays out any money. The jury is made up of three verified mentors; a juror never scores someone they have mentored.
